target: Complete chart authoring for FeedBack and Rocksmith 2014 authoring sources (DLC Builder projects)
publication: Local research and builds only. No Git push or publication authorized.
evidence_policy: Implemented behavior, tested behavior, retail observations and remaining gaps are distinguished.

features.capability: Menus, timeline, inspector, transport and error panel
features.status: Implemented; contextual menus and keyboard traversal, chart commands scoped to visible Tab/Tempo views, resizing, pointer-anchored zoom, separate view preferences and bounded virtual viewport browser verified. File > Arrangement info and Ctrl+Shift+I reveal the Settings inspector even when it is hidden. This is an original counterpart to captured native menu vocabulary; identical native modal behavior is not claimed
features.remaining: Exact current retail menu behavior is only partially observed.

features.capability: Fret entry, grid movement, selection, sustain dragging and techniques
features.status: Editing, matching selection, atomic transpose/string moves, slides, numeric tap, stroke direction, vibrato and force destination pitch implemented; optional per-string sustain clamp/gutter and repeated beat-tail edits pass eight browser checks
features.remaining: Sustain policy is an original optional behavior with documented purpose, not established exact retail exceptions. Force destination pitch is authoring metadata for JSON/FeedBack; Stock RS2014 has no established equivalent and rejects non-Auto export.

features.capability: Chord templates, library search, fingering, cloning, strums, hand shapes and gutter
features.status: Zones, fingerprints, arpeggios, hidden names, movement, split, bulk zone generation/removal, cursor bends and naming implemented; unit/browser checks pass; endpoint-only zone fitting previews explicit musical boundaries/gutter and protects existing tails, with13 unit and4 browser checks; inherited-only template finger synchronization across allDD/nativeXML, explicit overrides/source preservation and atomicUndo pass7unit/4browser checks; original4..8string live diagram/capo/thumb/Cancel/Undo passes4browser checks; anchor repair13unit/6browser checks preserve music/hiddenDD/source and bounded100-row preview
features.remaining: Current retail exact presentation and all native rendering distinctions still require parity review. Native endpoint command purpose is evidenced; the new fitting policy does not claim exact propagation or internal native units. Finger inheritance is explicit original policy: missing/equal-old values follow the template; other per-note values remain overrides.

features.capability: Merge paste and region operations across notes, chords, anchors, phrases, sections, tones and lyrics
features.status: All-structure regions and ordinary complete/partial chord clipboard browser workflows pass; 150,000-note clipboard regression passes Flat pitched phrase markers, IDs and unknown fields now persist through a versioned SHA-bound authoring record; stale/future metadata is withheld with warnings and preserved opaque, and explicit empty/absence intent cannot resurrect old markers.
features.remaining: Exact retail region-edge semantics remain a parity review item. Flat phrase markers are retained for R+ Workshop reopen; native FeedBack phrase playback requires authored native ladders. Original marker-to-ladder boundary policy is documented and not claimed exact retail behavior.

features.capability: Beat-map alignment, tap tempo, transient detection, tempo suggestions, ramps and meters; configurable grid/onset snapping, swing and atomic resnap
features.status: Implemented; principal sync workflows and real-browser swing/onset/resnap/undo checks pass; cursor BPM preserves earlier alignment, mixed-meter follow timing and Undo browser verified
features.remaining: Automatic suggestions are heuristic and require author review. Native tempoLock evidence indicates tempo-event markers in the observed conversion, not proven absolute-time protection locks.

features.capability: Independent preview pitch/speed, loops, speed ramps, count-in, metronome and guide mixer with mute/solo
features.status: Fast granular default and optional bounded spectral Worker/Worklet preview implemented; real audio tests verify mixed pitches, exact transport sync, loops/ramps/seek, pending cancellation, fallback and ten-minute-source short stress; frozen0.5 source passed45-minute EQ transition soak with60samples, exactsource/clock and clean teardown; deliberate600ms stall visibly falls back while fast playback continues. Original adaptive and MIDI cue production gates pass. The0.6 integrated soak failed at sample33 because its strict comparison sampled an advancing clock at different times; original failure retained. The revised0.7 harness uses strict coherent clock snapshots and getter brackets; its actual run status is recorded separately in the checkpoint evidence. No45-minute success is claimed for0.6. Actual0.7 strict silent-browser endurance passed60samples over2714.61wall seconds/1948.112context seconds, zero fallback, exact28-module/catalog closure and155of155 retirement acknowledgements before context close. Physical playback/latency/listening fidelity remains unverified. Actual0.8 fractional preview pitch passes five real UI workflows: one-cent input, exact original engine floats, focused Save, unchanged full JSON/scratch/hiddenDD/source, invalid limits and remount/reload preferences. No audio context or hardware was initialized by this setting-only gate. The final0.8 endurance result is recorded separately in checkpoint evidence.
features.remaining: Original spectral processing retains transient pre-echo and possible noise coloration; fast granular can smear or cancel mixed material. Native DSP and physical listening fidelity are unverified. Source exports keep original audio.

features.capability: Tone library, timed allocations, amp/cabinet/pedal/rack controls and native definitions
features.status: Native authoring/allocation/export and original audition for 68 of the 79 audited non-Distortion/non-Pitch descriptors, including partial Eden (48 of 58 non-Filter, 20 of 21 Filter), plus all five wah Auto-ON modes. The full 100-descriptor pedal/rack catalog has 84 original approximations: those 68 plus 16 generic distortion approximations. Production every-frame OfflineAudio/Worklet comparisons, bounded12-stage graph,200 acknowledged retirements before context close and8actual UI preparation/failure/routing workflows pass. Fractional controls and named enums remain exact; volume-only edits retain graphs. Actual0.7 production12-stage static graph and five real UI workflows verify fractional1375.125Hz, asynchronous catalog bypass/registration, volume-cache reuse, exact native/source/hidden-DD retention and complete disposal. Acoustic Emulator uses an explicitly original generic shelf/mid model; Range Booster uses original bounded broadband gain. Original Swole maps compressor controls with browser automatic makeup/lookahead; partial Eden models three EQ controls while five controls remain unmapped and disclosed. Original Amp EQ maps authored 1..100 controls to -12..+12 dB about midpoint 50.5, with original enum-selected bass 80/160 Hz, mid 400/800/1600 Hz and treble 2500/5000 Hz anchors, Q=1 and 20 Hz..0.45 sample-rate bounds. These original mappings are not native frequency/gain calibration. Exact native DSP remains unverified. Actual0.8 production OfflineAudio and six actual-main UI workflows pass with no module overlays and exact served/local hashes: input-normalized compression/recovery, three-band dB responses, twelve-stage finite bounded graph, five unmapped Eden controls disclosed/inaudible, fractional source units, six Undo, hidden DD/native JSON, graph reuse and disposal.
features.remaining: Sixteen of the full 100 pedal/rack descriptors remain bypassed: 11 in the audited 79-descriptor non-Distortion/non-Pitch subset and five Pitch descriptors (Bass Sub Octave, MultiPitch, OctaveUp!, Octavius and Studio Pitch). Unsupported controls stay disclosed. Models are original approximations, with no native/branded DSP fidelity claim. Unknown retirement acknowledgement degrades adaptive admission until context recreation; other effects remain usable.

features.capability: Editable difficulty levels, source-preserving generation and phrase maxima; copy/clear a phrase between authored levels
features.status: Implemented; uncovered/overlapping source projections refuse instead of dropping or duplicating rows. Explicit marker boundary edits rebuild original next-marker/song-end intervals; label-only changes keep native timing and unknown metadata.25 backend tests/36subtests plus four actual UI export/repair/reopen workflows pass.
features.remaining: Original progressive thinning is not claimed to match the native difficulty algorithm. Gapped/overlapping imported native ladders require explicit marker correction before export. Removing canonical levels while native source levels remain requires restoring levels or saving editable JSON; no automatic destructive flattening.

features.status: Original18-piece audition plus distinct imported custom-ID lanes, escaped source labels, all-level discovery and exact custom note entry/selection/undo/Feedpak roundtrip browser verified; SHA-bound authoring sidecar retains every level/group/zone; actual canonical18 native gate renders stack/bell in default fallback and own lanes, preserves user kit/source/DD/return context and refuses missing lanes before writes

features.capability: Feedpak, project JSON, arrangement/vocal XML, MIDI, multipart MusicXML/MXL, Guitar Pro 3-8 and GPA sync song folders
features.status: other adapters and opaque-source merge tested; numeric MusicXML dynamics(default forte90) and explicit sound tempo offsets tested; bounded original MXL archive plus extra files survives JSON/Feedpak without overriding edited charts. Timed approximate MIDI-GM adapter and durable source references are production tested separately. Plain MusicXML normalized source now also survives native Feedpak save/reopen via version2 score metadata, while compressed MXL version1 metadata stays byte exact; edited charts remain authoritative. Full backend249tests+109subtests pass with one Windows file-symlink creation privilege skip; actual directory-junction containment passes. Uniform GP6/7/8 fretted capo metadata now follows documented staff/track precedence; actual four-layout import and JSON/Feedpak/XML browser checks pass. Feedpak-owned SHA-bound role/priority metadata preserves explicit stock arrangements without using display-name inference. Tone, beat-map and arrangement imports reserve exact History/state/project/part/open intent before awaiting; stale, superseded or unmounted continuations cannot commit or replace dialogs.28 actual-handler tests and14 real UI workflows pass, including one-Undo full-project/hidden-DD preservation and latest-request ordering. Tone/tempo native inputs clear after capture so the same file can be selected again.
features.remaining: Native SNG reconstruction has disclosed rounding/scoring/transcription limitations. Conflicting/nonuniform, malformed or out-of-policy GP6-8 fretted capos are explicitly rejected; nonfretted source metadata is disclosed and retained. Unsupported MusicXML navigation/ornaments and MIDI format 2/SMPTE are rejected; source documents remain preserved. PSARC packages are refused: PSARC import and authoring were removed on 2026-10-24 (no use of the PSARC key).

features.capability: Native slap/pluck sentinels, note/chord mute semantics and numeric tap
features.status: Actual compiled SNG verifies independent technique masks, tap3 and every voice of a mixed-muted chord; UI/XML/Feedpak checks pass. Explicit authoring commands apply to selected notes/chord children: enabling palm mute clears fret-hand mute and its legacy mute alias; enabling fret-hand mute clears palm mute. Frets and unrelated data are retained, and imported contradictory flags remain unchanged until an explicit command edits them. The editor retains its aggregate-every selection rule (enable if any selected voice lacks the chosen technique) and local disable policy (leave the opposite mute flag unchanged; disabling fret-hand mute also clears its existing legacy alias). Target output projects PM/MT/FHM to Boolean flags: true or a positive finite legacy number enables; zero and negative values are inactive. Authored FHM/legacy MT aliases combine with OR after independent normalization. Current authored values and authoritative absence suppress cached source aliases. The editable master and original source data remain unchanged; invalid scalar or non-finite mute values are refused by existing general project validation.
features.remaining: Packaging mixed-muted chords requires simultaneous-note presentation, disclosed in build warnings. Native mixed-selection ordering, current-retail open-versus-retain mute commands and all native rhythm-marker disable semantics remain unestablished. Bend intent/teaching marks have no native note attributes and produce export warnings.
